purpose: Run the smallest source-disjoint P2 screen capable of falsifying the four-example P1 engineering success before spending any more optimizer budget.

population.rationale: Exact homologous performance names and same capture view as the P1 engineering examples isolate performer shift while holding content category/name and input modality fixed.
population.cropRule: independent deterministic source-only earliest launch-ready crop; no model-output selection

screenThresholds.note: This tiny screen reuses only event thresholds that are computable on four cropped examples; it is not the full historical development fold acceptance test.

outcomes.green: Evidence supports designing a broader P1/P2 development evaluation. Does not authorize P3 or full training.
outcomes.red: Stop broader training and diagnose performer-shift failure first.
outcomes.inconclusive: Missing/unresolved selected capture or non-finite metric fails closed; redesign before further compute.

hardClaimBoundary: This four-example P2 screen cannot establish final generalization, customer readiness, production eligibility, or justify opening P3.
